Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 点击并拖拽高亮物品到发声槽中，看看它隐藏着什么。
English(en): Click and drag the highlighted item into the speaking slot to see what it reveals.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 找到马克逃脱孤岛的方式。
English(en): Discover how Mark escaped the island.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 工作间
English(en): Workshop

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 这里是一片孤岛，被终年低温的海水包围着，没有桥梁，唯一可以离开的途径武装巡逻渡船。“恶魔的监狱”，等待囚犯们的只有终身的监禁。　　然而就在昨天，监狱的警铃响了一整夜，我的狱友，马克，挖开通风管道越狱了，留在他床上的只有一个粗制滥造的仿真假人。
English(en): This place is an island surrounded by frigid waters year-round. There are no bridges; the only way off is the armed patrol ferry. The Devil’s Prison—all that awaits its inmates is a lifetime behind bars. Yet yesterday, the prison alarms rang all night. My cellmate, Mark, dug through the ventilation shaft and escaped, leaving nothing on his bed but a crude dummy.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 马克用马达改装钻头挖开通风管道，用打磨好的勺子磨制船桨，通过蒸汽江粘合橡胶雨衣做成筏子和救生衣，再以手风琴改装充气泵为筏子充气，最后乘船逃离。
English(en): Mark fitted a drill with the motor and broke through the ventilation shaft. He sharpened a spoon to shape an oar, used steam to bond rubber raincoats into a raft and life jacket, converted the accordion into a pump to inflate the raft, and finally sailed away.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 找出警察死亡的真相。
English(en): Uncover the truth behind the police officer’s death.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 旅馆吧台
English(en): Inn Bar

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 离开监狱以后，我们在一间旅馆落脚。我说"我们"，是指我和负责我的警察——一个过分古板的年轻人，相对于他的年龄而言。傍晚，小镇上逐渐被浓雾笼罩，旅馆仿佛成了另外一座孤岛。我在吧台待了许久，也不见那个小警察请我喝一杯，连店里屡屡向他献殷勤的女酒保也没有得到回应。就在我感到没趣准备休息时，窗外传来了一声惨叫——这个年轻的警察倒在地上，已经没有了心跳，四周只有我们自己的脚印。
English(en): After leaving the prison, we stopped at an inn. By “we,” I mean myself and the police officer assigned to me—a young man far too straitlaced for his age. By evening, thick fog had swallowed the town, turning the inn into yet another island. I lingered at the bar for ages, but the young officer never offered me a drink. He did not even respond to the barmaid’s repeated attempts to charm him. Just as boredom drove me toward bed, a scream came from outside. The young officer lay on the ground, his heart already still, with no footprints around him but our own.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 警察由于智齿发炎正在服用消炎药，女酒保将他的饮料换成了酒，导致警察中毒头晕离开酒馆，倒地身亡。由于浓雾和湿度，现场的脚印被掩盖了。
English(en): The officer was taking anti-inflammatory medicine for an infected wisdom tooth. The barmaid replaced his drink with alcohol, and the interaction poisoned him. Dizzy, he left the inn, collapsed, and died. The heavy fog and moisture concealed the footprints at the scene.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 找出恶魔移动的真相。
English(en): Uncover the truth behind the moving demon.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 伯爵家的礼拜堂
English(en): Chapel at the Count’s Estate

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 我成功破获案件的出色能力被一名恰巧被困此处的公爵欣赏，在浓雾散去后，她邀请我前往他的宅邸做客。尽管以我囚犯的身份不应该在没有警察时随意活动，为了更快寻找马克，战胜恶魔，我还是答应了他。不过事情果然没有那么简单，在我入住公爵府的当晚，深夜传来一声尖叫。公爵家的女儿声称看到画里的恶魔移动了。任务：找出恶魔移动的真相。
English(en): My success in solving the case caught the attention of a noblewoman who happened to be stranded there. Once the fog lifted, she invited me to stay at her estate. Though, as a prisoner, I should not be wandering around without a police escort, I accepted in hopes of finding Mark—and defeating the demon—sooner. Of course, things were not so simple. On my first night at the estate, a scream rang out in the dead of night. The noblewoman’s daughter claimed she had seen the demon in the painting move. Objective: uncover the truth behind the moving demon.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 伯爵一家决定卖掉这幅画，真心喜爱这幅画的鉴定师决定悄悄偷走它，并摆上赝品。在行动中为了防止被半夜下楼的伯爵小姐发现只得把画作挂在不属于它的地方，导致伯爵小姐以为画中是恶魔移动了。
English(en): The count’s family decided to sell the painting. The appraiser, who truly loved it, planned to steal it in secret and replace it with a forgery. When the count’s daughter came downstairs in the middle of the night, the appraiser had to hang the painting in the wrong place to avoid being discovered, making her think the demon inside it had moved.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 吸尘器
English(en): Vacuum Cleaner

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 坏了的吸尘器，打开查看后发现马达消失了
English(en): A broken vacuum cleaner. Opening it reveals that the motor is missing.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 蒸汽管道
English(en): Steam Pipe

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 附在上面的是，橡胶雨衣？完全被烤化了，好刺鼻的味道。
English(en): Is that a rubber raincoat stuck to it? It has melted completely. What a pungent smell.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 铁栏窗
English(en): Barred Window

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 这里的海水终年低温，风浪极大，如果游泳的话会被毋庸置疑地冻死，不过每年都有这样的傻蛋。
English(en): The sea stays frigid all year, and the waves are vicious. Anyone who tries to swim will freeze to death without question, though every year some fool still tries.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 手风琴
English(en): Accordion

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 音调不准的手风琴。哈，真怀念，说不定下一次的联欢会我要一个人上台表演了。
English(en): An accordion that is out of tune. Ha, how nostalgic. Perhaps I’ll give a solo performance at the next gathering.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 餐勺
English(en): Spoon

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 偷出来的餐勺，侧边被打磨出刃口，锋利且危险。
English(en): A stolen spoon with one edge ground into a blade. Sharp and dangerous.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 口袋里的病历
English(en): Medical Record in His Pocket

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 智齿发炎，按医嘱服用……（后面看不清了）。哈，难怪他的话和我一样少。
English(en): Infected wisdom tooth. Take as directed by the doctor… The rest is illegible. Ha, no wonder he talks as little as I do.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 白色的粉末
English(en): White Powder

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 吧台上散落的白色粉末，粘在手指上舔了舔，味道很古怪，看来他们没有做盐边玛格丽特。
English(en): White powder scattered across the bar. I dabbed some on my finger and tasted it. Strange flavor. It seems they were not making a salt-rimmed margarita.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 酒杯
English(en): Wine Glass

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 酒杯里残留着粉红色的液体。伏特加，还有……很浓的果香。
English(en): Pink liquid remains in the glass. Vodka, and… a very strong fruit aroma.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 窗户
English(en): Window

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 浓雾掩盖了一切，空气里潮湿又黏腻。而我们，被困在了这里，在雾散以前，谁也不会来。这到底是好事还是坏事呢？
English(en): The thick fog hides everything, and the air is damp and clammy. We are trapped here. No one will come until the fog lifts. Is that a good thing or a bad thing?

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 手枪
English(en): Pistol

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 警察身份的象征。检查过膛线和弹匣，没有使用过的迹象。不过在这种情况下，还是放在大家都能看见的地方为妙。
English(en): A symbol of police authority. I checked the rifling and magazine; there is no sign it has been fired. Even so, under the circumstances, it is best to leave it where everyone can see it.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 鉴定书
English(en): Appraisal Certificate

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 鉴定结论显示，本件为原作。出自最近借住在伯爵府邸的鉴定家，对画作作者了解甚多。
English(en): The appraisal concludes that this piece is an original. It was issued by the appraiser recently staying at the count’s estate, who knows a great deal about the artist.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 《圣安东尼的诱惑》
English(en): The Temptation of Saint Anthony

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 16世纪博斯的著名画作，形制为三联可开合祭坛画，分为中联、左翼、右翼，每一联画作均尺寸巨大……嘘，我只是在读鉴定书上的字。
English(en): A famous sixteenth-century painting by Bosch. It is a hinged triptych altarpiece divided into a central panel, left wing, and right wing, each enormous in size… Shh, I’m only reading what the appraisal says.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 公爵一家的全家福
English(en): Portrait of the Duke’s Family

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 和现在的伯爵府相比少了不少东西，也许伯爵家不像我想象地那么富裕。
English(en): Compared with the count’s estate as it is now, quite a few things are missing. Perhaps the family is not as wealthy as I imagined.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 渔具桶
English(en): Fishing-Tackle Bucket

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 摆放在门口的渔具桶，和宅邸内的其他陈设有些格格不入。说不定伯爵一家有钓鱼的狂热爱好者。
English(en): A bucket of fishing gear by the door, oddly out of place among the estate’s other furnishings. Perhaps someone in the count’s family is an avid angler.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 小推车
English(en): Trolley

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 多段手电筒、手持放大镜、小型偏光镜——其他的我都不认识。很有说服力的鉴定工具，以至于它的主人拿了一个小推车来装它们。
English(en): A multi-section flashlight, a handheld magnifying glass, a small polarizing lens—and several other things I do not recognize. Such an impressive collection of appraisal tools that their owner needed a trolley to carry them.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 恃勇行凶
English(en): Brute Force

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 只身涉水
English(en): Swim for It

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 乘风破浪
English(en): Ride the Wind and Waves

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 饮鸩止渴
English(en): Drink Poison to Quench Thirst

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 耽酒嗜饮
English(en): Drink to Excess

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 良药苦口
English(en): Bitter Medicine

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 杯弓蛇影
English(en): Jump at Shadows

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 败家卖产
English(en): Sell the Family Fortune

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 偷梁换柱
English(en): Swap the Real for the Fake

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 我很期待，这一次又要上演什么样的闹剧？
English(en): I can’t wait to see what kind of farce you’ll stage this time.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 你这是在火中取栗，亲爱的，你觉得你的好运能持续多久？
English(en): You’re playing with fire, darling. How long do you think your luck will last?

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 哈，你挣扎的样子真让我感动……
English(en): Ha, the way you struggle is truly touching…

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 你会后悔的，你会非常，非常后悔，我保证。
English(en): You’ll regret this. You’ll regret it very, very much. I promise.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 你是对的，咱们是时候找点乐子了。
English(en): You’re right. It’s time we had some fun.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 好吧，偶尔给你一个小小的甜头也不算太坏。
English(en): Very well. There’s no harm in giving you a tiny reward now and then.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 现在认输还来得及，别担心，我喜欢识时务的人。
English(en): There’s still time to surrender. Don’t worry—I like people who know when they’re beaten.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 你以为这就结束了吗，不，宝贝，那些梦魇永远不会放过你，它们会像是不安分的骨头，咯吱咯吱响个不停，缠着你、折磨你，永远、永远……
English(en): You think it’s over? No, baby. Those nightmares will never leave you. They’ll be like restless bones, creaking without end—haunting you, tormenting you, forever and ever…

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 粗陋的陈设、蹩脚的配角，我们的主人公要怎么在这样的舞台上大放异彩呢？
English(en): Shabby scenery, hopeless supporting players—how is our hero supposed to shine on a stage like this?

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 别高兴得太早了，我们来日方长呢。
English(en): Don’t celebrate too soon. We have a long road ahead of us.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 别怪我，亲爱的，这都是你自讨苦吃。
English(en): Don’t blame me, darling. You brought this suffering on yourself.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 呵呵，你逃不掉的，命运的绳索已经勒住了你的咽喉，一切都是徒劳，我们终究会在地狱里再见……
English(en): Heh. You can’t escape. Fate’s rope is already tightening around your throat. All your efforts are in vain. In the end, we’ll meet again in hell…

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 噢，亲爱的，你不喜欢做梦，我知道的。嘘，嘘，嘘，放心吧，这里什么也没有，没有蒙冤而死的罪人，没有审判庭无休无止的灯光……只有一片黑暗，黑——暗——温暖而湿润，想起来了吗，泥土化开的气息、稻草扎在脸上的触感，答对了，科威特郡的旧谷仓！
English(en): Oh, darling, you don’t like dreaming. I know. Shh, shh, shh. Don’t worry, there’s nothing here—no wrongfully condemned prisoners, no endless lights of the tribunal… only darkness. Dark—ness—warm and damp. Do you remember now? The smell of thawing earth, the prick of straw against your face. That’s right: the old barn in Kuwait County!

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 你已经走得太远了，宝贝，这趟旅途把你累坏了，现在，是时候该回家了。
English(en): You’ve come too far, baby. This journey has worn you out. Now it’s time to go home.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 不，不，不能再等了，我们必须现在就启程，赶在今年的苹果树开花之前……
English(en): No, no, we can’t wait any longer. We must leave now, before the apple trees bloom this year…

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 好吧，请你告诉我，你到底在等什么？等不存在的正义，等不会来的宽恕，还是等……
English(en): Then tell me: what exactly are you waiting for? Justice that doesn’t exist? Forgiveness that will never come? Or are you waiting for…

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 啊哈，大胆的想法，从这一点看来，我们彼此彼此呢。
English(en): Aha, what a daring idea. In that respect, you and I are rather alike.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 不过，你知道的，凡是交易均有代价。五句话——每一次你只能说四句话，四句话以内，如果你甜美的真相没有俯首称臣，你就死了，宝贝。
English(en): But you know every bargain has its price. Five statements—each time, you may speak only four. If your sweet truth has not surrendered within those four statements, you die, baby.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 我得给你个给忠告，这是一条有去无回的险途，而你，亲爱的，是个两手空空的赌徒，必须押上你的全部。灵魂、肉体，呵呵呵呵呵……我会竭尽所能让你惨败。噢，说什么呢，你当然有这些东西。
English(en): Let me give you a word of advice. This is a perilous road with no return, and you, darling, are an empty-handed gambler who must stake everything. Soul, flesh—hehehehe… I’ll do everything in my power to make you lose. Oh, what am I saying? Of course you have those things.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 考虑好了，呵呵，真爽快，请在这里签下你的名字。
English(en): Made up your mind? Heh, how decisive. Sign your name here.

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 时间诅咒：发言次数减少
English(en): Time Curse: Fewer Statements

Chinese (Simplified)(zh-Hans): 我看见你生命的倒计时在减少咯，让我来加速一下吧......
English(en): I can see the countdown on your life ticking down. Let me speed it up…
